Counts segments, not miles — no reliable per-segment length field exists without computing one from geometry, and this pipeline does not guess a units-bearing figure. No public dataset source exists for this metric as of 2026-09-17. Do not attempt to derive it from street_construction_permits' free-text fields (see that dataset's role above for why). DOT testimony is the only source, and the most recent (first Mamdani-era) testimony gives no intersection count at all — see config/testimony.yaml fy27_executive.

Polygon inventory (k5k6-6jex) total as of extraction: 93 plazas citywide; that dataset has no install-date field, so it alone supports no year split. Adams/Mamdani totals here instead come from Pedestrian Space Added (uebm-cmjr) project counts, bucketed by NYC fiscal year (not exact calendar date) — a capital-project count, not a plaza count. FY2022 absent from the dataset (not yet published, or a genuine reporting gap) — excluded from the Adams total below rather than counted as zero. FY2026 (the fiscal year spanning the Adams/Mamdani transition) has not been published in this dataset as of extraction — Mamdani to-date total is unavailable, not zero. FY22 (Jul 2021-Jun 2022) and FY26 (Jul 2025-Jun 2026) each straddle an administration transition; this fiscal-year bucketing is a disclosed approximation, not an exact administration-window split.
